title: Http2ClientConnection attempts to write to a null stream when write queued

comments.body:
I have run into the same.  In my scnenario, I am making a streaming grpc client call.  

```
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "io.netty.handler.codec.http2.Http2Stream.id()" because "stream" is null
	at io.vertx.core.http.impl.VertxHttp2ConnectionHandler.writeData(VertxHttp2ConnectionHandler.java:234)
	at io.vertx.core.http.impl.VertxHttp2Stream.doWriteData(VertxHttp2Stream.java:300)
	at io.vertx.core.http.impl.Http2ClientConnection$Stream.doWriteData(Http2ClientConnection.java:276)
	at io.vertx.core.http.impl.VertxHttp2Stream$4.write(VertxHttp2Stream.java:274)
	at io.vertx.core.http.impl.VertxHttp2Stream$2.test(VertxHttp2Stream.java:89)
	at io.vertx.core.http.impl.VertxHttp2Stream$2.test(VertxHttp2Stream.java:84)
	at io.vertx.core.streams.impl.OutboundWriteQueue.drainLoop(OutboundWriteQueue.java:308)
	at io.vertx.core.streams.impl.OutboundWriteQueue.drain(OutboundWriteQueue.java:274)
	at io.vertx.core.internal.concurrent.OutboundMessageQueue.drainWriteQueue(OutboundMessageQueue.java:154)
	at io.netty.util.concurrent.AbstractEventExecutor.runTask(AbstractEventExecutor.java:148)
	at io.netty.util.concurrent.AbstractEventExecutor.safeExecute(AbstractEventExecutor.java:141)
	at io.netty.util.concurrent.SingleThreadEventExecutor.runAllTasks(SingleThreadEventExecutor.java:521)
	at io.netty.channel.SingleThreadIoEventLoop.run(SingleThreadIoEventLoop.java:160)
	at io.netty.util.concurrent.SingleThreadEventExecutor$5.run(SingleThreadEventExecutor.java:1123)
	at io.netty.util.internal.ThreadExecutorMap$2.run(ThreadExecutorMap.java:74)
	at io.netty.util.concurrent.FastThreadLocalRunnable.run(FastThreadLocalRunnable.java:30)
	at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:1583
```

A very important thing to note.  My application is clusterered, and I hit this when I am using InfinispanClusterManager, however when I switch to ZookeeperClusterManager I do not see ever hit the error, although maybe this is just from some added latency between the two and this is just a circumstantial race condition.

I only see issues from client side of grpc communication.  I never hit this error on the server side which is also a clustered vertx application, although possible that it is also just due to a race, as even on the client side it is intermittent (and the client side makes the call right away on verticle startup).

This is using vertx 5.0.0.CR4.  

@zekronium were you able to find any workarounds?
it seems in both case write is done from a non event loop thread like a worker ?

Hi @vietj My write is coming from a periodioc task, so should be the same thread as verticle correct?  

[Here is where I am hitting this in an example project](https://github.com/moonkev/vertx-playground/blob/1bb66603155de09347d5363a51d1575c123a436d/src/main/kotlin/com/github/moonkev/vertx_playground/verticle/FibonacciBotVerticle.kt#L31)

Note it seems today though I can only hit it using VIRTUAL_THREAD as my threading model, however I could have sworn I was also able to reproduce using EVENT_LOOP.  Definitely a race condition somewhere though, as even with VIRTUAL_THREAD I can sometimes dodge the error.
